dct_description_sm:
This dataset defines the geographic boundaries of fire service coverage areas across Prince Edward 
Island. Each zone identifies the fire department responsible for emergency response within that area. 
The dataset supports dispatch operations, emergency planning, resource allocation, and public safety 
analysis.

Each row represents a single Fire Coverage Zone polygon and its associated attributes.
